    Annex 1 - Saltblock moving diagonally¶

    Aim of Tutorial¶

    This tutorial slightly complexifies the salt block simulation by changing from unidirectional advection to bi-directional advection and showcases its consequences.

    Running the simulation¶

    To make the required changes and run the simulation you can uncomment and execute the cell below

    In [24]:
    Copied! 
    """%%bash


#Insert below the directory path in which you will run the simulations
#It should look like so : /.../EXP$$

DIR=

cd /"$DIR"

#We have to remove any file with the same name before running the simulation out of precaution
#rm CANAL_saltblock_diag_cen2_all_grid.nc
#rm CANAL_saltblock_diag_cen4_all_grid.nc
#rm CANAL_saltblock_diag_ubs_all_grid.nc
#rm CANAL_saltblock_diag_fct2_all_grid.nc
#rm CANAL_saltblock_diag_fct4_all_grid.nc


chmod -R a+x /"$DIR"/NEMO_Demonstrators/annex1_cfg/

bash /"$DIR"/NEMO_Demonstrators/annex1_cfg/diag_cfg.sh "$DIR"
bash "$DIR"/NEMO_Demonstrators/annex1_cfg/diag_istate.sh "$DIR"

bash /"$DIR"/NEMO_Demonstrators/annex1_cfg/cen_cfg.sh "$DIR"; sh /"$DIR"/NEMO_Demonstrators/annex1_cfg/fct_cfg.sh "$DIR"; bash /"$DIR"/NEMO_Demonstrators/annex1_cfg/ubs_cfg.sh "$DIR"
"""

    def show_t (t_list, param, title, file, rep=rep):
    " show_t displays a field from an xarray at given timesteps"
    "t_list : list of the timesteps displayed"
    "param : field displayed"
    "title : title of the figure"
    "file : name of the .nc array"
    "rep : path to the file (directory mentioned above by default)"

    dataset = xr.open_dataset(rep+file)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(t_list), figsize=(10, 3))
    for i, t in enumerate(t_list) : 
        # We select and show the desired field at different timesteps and at sea surface, excluding the walls
        data = dataset[param].isel(time_counter = t, deptht = 0)[1:-1, :]
        im = axes[i].imshow(data, origin='lower', cmap='coolwarm')
        axes[i].set_title(f'{title} at (t={t+1} days)')
        axes[i].set_xlabel('x')
        axes[i].set_ylabel('y')
        fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes[i])
    plt.show()
    dataset.close()
    def show_t (t_list, param, title, file, rep=rep): " show_t displays a field from an xarray at given timesteps" "t_list : list of the timesteps displayed" "param : field displayed" "title : title of the figure" "file : name of the .nc array" "rep : path to the file (directory mentioned above by default)" dataset = xr.open_dataset(rep+file) fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(t_list), figsize=(10, 3)) for i, t in enumerate(t_list) : # We select and show the desired field at different timesteps and at sea surface, excluding the walls data = dataset[param].isel(time_counter = t, deptht = 0)[1:-1, :] im = axes[i].imshow(data, origin='lower', cmap='coolwarm') axes[i].set_title(f'{title} at (t={t+1} days)') axes[i].set_xlabel('x') axes[i].set_ylabel('y') fig.colorbar(im, ax=axes[i]) plt.show() dataset.close()

    t_list = [1, 47]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, len(t_list), figsize=(10,6))

for i,t in enumerate(t_list):
    for n, ds in soce.items() :
        ax[0][i].plot(np.arange(ds.shape[1]), ds.isel(x_grid_T=50, time_counter=t), '--', color = colors[n], label = n)
        ax[1][i].plot(np.arange(ds.shape[2]), ds.isel(y_grid_T=50, time_counter=t), '--', color = colors[n], label = n)
    ax[0][i].set_xlabel('x')
    ax[0][i].set_ylabel('psu')
    ax[0][i].set_ylim(28,38)
    ax[1][i].set_ylim(28,38)
    ax[0][i].set_title(f' Salinity value along the x-axis at t={t} days')
    ax[1][i].set_title(f' Salinity value along the y-axis at t={t} days')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.legend()

    Salinity variance¶

    In [10]:
    Copied! 
    for n, ds in schemes.items() :
    if '4' in n:
        marker = ':'
    elif '2' in n :
        marker = '--'
    soce =ds['soce'].isel(deptht=0)
    sc = soce.mean( dim=('x_grid_T', 'y_grid_T'))
    s2c =soce**2
    s2c = s2c.mean( dim=('x_grid_T', 'y_grid_T'))
    dep = np.arange(len(s2c))
    var = (s2c-sc**2)
    plt.plot(dep,  var, marker, color =colors[n], label = n)
    

plt.title("Salinity variance over time")
plt.xlabel('t')

plt.legend()
plt.show()
    for n, ds in schemes.items() : if '4' in n: marker = ':' elif '2' in n : marker = '--' soce =ds['soce'].isel(deptht=0) sc = soce.mean( dim=('x_grid_T', 'y_grid_T')) s2c =soce**2 s2c = s2c.mean( dim=('x_grid_T', 'y_grid_T')) dep = np.arange(len(s2c)) var = (s2c-sc**2) plt.plot(dep, var, marker, color =colors[n], label = n) plt.title("Salinity variance over time") plt.xlabel('t') plt.legend() plt.show()
